executive_summary: The cybersecurity landscape has shifted to a CRITICAL threat level today, driven by a surge in high-impact, unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) vulnerabilities across critical infrastructure and development tooling. The discovery of vulnerabilities in LiteLLM (CVE-2026-40217) and REDCap (CVE-2026-90817) presents significant risks to AI-integrated pipelines and research data environments, respectively. Organizations must prioritize patching these alongside the newly reported Nginx RCE, which threatens the foundational layer of web infrastructure. Immediate remediation, including strict adherence to CISA BOD 26-04, is mandatory to mitigate the risk of widespread exploitation of these high-EPSS vulnerabilities.
key_takeaways: Critical RCE vulnerabilities identified in LiteLLM and REDCap require immediate patching due to high exploitability and potential for unauthenticated access.
The release of Qwen3.8-27B and MiniMax-H3-Image marks a significant expansion in high-performance open-weights models, increasing the attack surface for AI-native applications.
New research into agentic checkpointing (StatePortal) and scene rigidity (StrideWorld) highlights the industry's focus on stabilizing interactive AI agents.
Nginx and Rails-based infrastructure are currently under heightened scrutiny following reports of pre-authentication RCE vectors.
Developer tooling is trending toward specialized hardware management and protocol reverse-engineering, necessitating increased vigilance against supply chain risks.

cves.title: Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output Vulnerability
cves.description: Synology DSM contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the system plugin daemon in Synology BeeStation OS (BSM) that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors.
cves.remediation: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk.

cves.title: BerriAI LiteLLM Unprotected Alternate Channel Vulnerability
cves.description: BerriAI LiteLLM contains an unprotected alternate channel vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code URI.
cves.remediation: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk.

cves.title: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) Code Injection Vulnerability
cves.description: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server.
cves.remediation: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk.

cves.title: Apache Axis Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
cves.description: Apache Axis contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted SOAP fault message.
cves.remediation: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk.

cves.title: Perforce Puppet Enterprise Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
cves.description: Perforce Puppet Enterprise contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Puppet’s report-processing code that allows a client with any CA-signed agent certificate to execute arbitrary code.
cves.remediation: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk.
